message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 这周排班又改了 周日倒是空出来了

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 但我不想又在家躺一天

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 那别躺 去捏个杯子？

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 捏杯子？我手残

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 而且周日可能要去接我姐的孩子

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 我姐说孩子她带 周日不用我

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 你那边有想好吗

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 周日两点 有家陶艺体验 老师带着做 手残也能捏出来

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 我在小红书看到这个杯子 好好看

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 这种拉坯是不是很难

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 今天药房忙到飞起

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 感觉最近整个人是空的

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 周日要不还是算了 我想在家躺着

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 再说吧

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 我今天睡够了 其实还是想出去走走

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 但别太累

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 那周日下午 做一小时杯子 累了就撤

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 你最近是不是也很累

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 看你回消息都变短了

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 我姐刚说她周日临时有事 孩子可能还是得我带

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 半天 下午三点前来接

message_index.speaker: ME
message_index.quote: 那三点后 做一小时杯子 来得及

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 带他一起去行吗 他六岁

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 不行我就再想办法

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 那周日两点见

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 你别又加班放我鸽子

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 今天挺开心的

message_index.speaker: HER
message_index.quote: 杯子我烤好了 下次给你看
